bullets.id: Emas spot membuka pekan dengan rebound tipis: naik 0,36% ke $4.154,8 pukul 07:54 WIB. Pendorongnya masih data tenaga kerja Jumat: hanya 29 ribu lapangan kerja di September (perkiraan 90 ribu), pengangguran naik ke 4,2%, dan upah tahunan melambat ke 3,0%, terlemah sejak Mei 2021.
bullets.en: Spot gold opened the week with a slight rebound: up 0.36% to $4,154.8 at 07:54 WIB. The driver is still Friday’s jobs data: just 29,000 jobs in September (forecast 90,000), unemployment up to 4.2%, and annual wage growth slowing to 3.0%, the weakest since May 2021.

bullets.id: Kenaikan tertahan karena dolar dan yield tetap kuat. Indeks dolar naik 0,37% ke 102,31, dekat level tertinggi sejak April 2025, dan yield 10 tahun di atas 5,25%, tertinggi sejak 2002. Pasar memperkirakan peluang Fed menahan suku bunga Oktober sekitar 80%, tapi peluang kenaikan Desember masih sekitar 69%. Emas turun 5,85% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: Gains are capped because the dollar and yields stay strong. The dollar index rose 0.37% to 102.31, near its highest since April 2025, and the 10-year yield is above 5.25%, the highest since 2002. Markets see about an 80% chance the Fed holds in October, but December hike odds are still about 69%. Gold is down 5.85% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Level yang dipantau: $4.100 lalu $4.000 di bawah, $4.200 di atas. Malam ini ISM Jasa September (perkiraan 55,1 dari 55,4), lalu risalah FOMC Rabu dan klaim pengangguran Kamis; CPI AS keluar 14 Oktober. Minyak WTI turun 0,59% ke $89,85 setelah OPEC+ menahan produksi November.
bullets.en: Levels in focus: $4,100 then $4,000 below, $4,200 above. Tonight brings September ISM Services (forecast 55.1 from 55.4), then the FOMC minutes on Wednesday and jobless claims on Thursday; US CPI is due October 14. WTI crude fell 0.59% to $89.85 after OPEC+ held November output steady.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp6.000 ke Rp2.580.000, kenaikan pertama setelah tiga hari turun, dengan buyback Rp2.386.000 (spread Rp194.000, sekitar 7,5%). Galeri24 tetap Rp2.506.000 (buyback Rp2.364.000), Rp74.000 lebih murah dari Antam, dan UBS tetap Rp2.530.000 (buyback Rp2.338.000).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram bar rose Rp6,000 to Rp2,580,000, the first gain after three days of declines, with a Rp2,386,000 buyback (Rp194,000 spread, about 7.5%). Galeri24 is unchanged at Rp2,506,000 (buyback Rp2,364,000), Rp74,000 cheaper than Antam, and UBS is unchanged at Rp2,530,000 (buyback Rp2,338,000).
